headline: BFIU seeks bank account details of Salman Muqtadir
summary: The financial intelligence unit has directed banks and financial institutions to provide transaction records and KYC documents of the content creator.
details: The Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit (BFIU) has summoned the bank account information of content creator Salman Muqtadir.
Various banks and financial institutions across the country have been directed to provide details of his accounts and related transactions.
The BFIU has specifically requested account opening forms, Know Your Customer (KYC) documents, and detailed transaction histories.
While the BFIU has requested the information, the specific reason for the summons has not been immediately disclosed.
This development follows a recent incident where Salman Muqtadir's studio at New Greenery Properties in the ECB circle area of the capital was attacked and vandalized.
Following the attack, Muqtadir had accused the ruling party and the government of involvement, leading to significant discussion and counter-arguments on social media.
caption:
BFIU summons bank details of content creator Salman Muqtadir. What is the reason behind this financial probe?

The Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit (BFIU) has summoned the bank account information of content creator Salman Muqtadir.

Various banks and financial institutions across the country have been directed to provide details of his accounts and related transactions.

The BFIU has specifically requested account opening forms, Know Your Customer (KYC) documents, and detailed transaction histories.

While the BFIU has requested the information, the specific reason for the summons has not been immediately disclosed.

This development follows a recent incident where Salman Muqtadir's studio at New Greenery Properties in the ECB circle area of the capital was attacked and vandalized.

Following the attack, Muqtadir had accused the ruling party and the government of involvement, leading to significant discussion and counter-arguments on social media.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo

headline: Mirpur eviction drive: 3 city corporation vehicles torched amid clash
summary: Violence erupted during a footpath eviction drive in Mirpur-10, Dhaka, as hawkers clashed with police and city corporation workers. Three vehicles were set ablaze and several people were injured.
details: A clash broke out in Mirpur-10, Dhaka, on Wednesday when law enforcement and city corporation officials attempted to clear footpaths of hawkers. The situation escalated quickly, leading to significant vandalism and arson.

During the unrest, three Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) vehicles were set on fire. Additionally, vehicles belonging to the police and journalists present at the scene were vandalized. Several individuals sustained injuries in the ensuing chaos.

Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal stated on Sunday that a lack of coordination between the magistrate and police likely caused the clash. He has ordered an investigation into the incident, emphasizing that the magistrate did not adequately communicate with the police regarding the operation.

DNCC Administrator has alleged that individuals associated with fascism were behind the attacks and vandalism during the eviction drive. Authorities have vowed to take swift action against those involved.
